sections.heading: B — Audience and scope
sections.markdown:
## B — Audience and scope

Audience: first-time Hawaii class three applicants, including minors on the graduated path, learning county registration and yearly licensing, first registration, titles and liens, renewal by mail and online, address and name changes on the registration, armed forces and disabled veteran exemptions, ownership documents for new and used vehicles bought in Hawaii, other states or abroad, temporary permits, license plate display and moped registration in plain English.

Prerequisites: the safety inspection rules from the previous section, since a current inspection certificate is a precondition for registration.

Scope note: county registration and yearly licensing, first registration, title and lien holding, renewal by mail and online, address and name changes on the registration, armed forces and disabled veteran exemptions, ownership documents for new and used vehicles bought in Hawaii, in another state or abroad, temporary permits for out-of-state vehicles, license plate display and moped registration. The driver's own fitness follows in the next section.

Recall emphasis: the thirty-day change rules, the twelve-month permit ceiling, plate placement and the document lists are practiced as recall items; no scenario or recognition surface is needed for this section.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the county registration and yearly licensing, first registration, titles and liens, renewal by mail and online, address and name changes on the registration, armed forces and disabled veteran exemptions, ownership documents for new and used vehicles bought in Hawaii, other states or abroad, temporary permits, license plate display and moped registration rules on pages 21–23 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
